agent.title: Umufasha w'igikoni
agent.imageAttached: Ifoto yometseho — ongeraho ubutumwa cyangwa uyohereze uko iri.
agent.fabHint: Kanda igihe kirekire kugira ngo uvuge
agent.stockPhotoPrompt: Mfasha kubara ibiri mu bubiko kuri iyi foto.
agent.stillWorking: Biracyakorwa… ushobora guhagarika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
agent.attachHint: Ohereza menu, ifunguro, urupapuro rw'ibyakiriwe cyangwa akabati k'ububiko. Inyandiko ziri ku mafoto zisomwa nk'amakuru gusa.
agent.cameraDenied: Kamera ntiyemerewe. Yemerere mu Igenamiterere kugira ngo ufate ifoto.
agent.noKitchenBody: Hitamo igikoni kugira ngo umufasha amenye ububiko na menu akoresha.
agent.emptyBody: Mbaza ku bubiko, ibyagurishijwe n'ikiguzi cy'ibiribwa, cyangwa umbwire icyo nandika. Buri gihe ndabaza mbere yo guhindura ikintu.

suggestions.title: Gerageza kubaza
suggestions.foodCostAny: Ni irihe funguro rifite ikiguzi cy'ibiribwa kinini?

route.menuBody: Winjiza amafunguro ayirimo? Uzagenzura buri kintu mbere y'uko hagira ikibikwa.
route.dishBody: Urishyira kuri menu nk'ikintu kimwe, AI igusabira ibikoresho n'igiciro?
route.deliveryBody: Ufungura kwandika ibyakiriwe ukoresheje iyi foto? Uzagenzura buri murongo mbere yo kubika.
route.stockBody: Ndagufasha kubibara — buri gihinduka gisaba ko ubyemeza.
route.otherBody: Ohereza menu icapye cyangwa yanditse n'intoki, ifunguro rimwe, urupapuro rw'ibyakiriwe cyangwa akabati k'ububiko, biri hasi kandi bibonesheje neza.

voice.stop: Hagarika gufata amajwi maze bihindurwe inyandiko
voice.micDenied: Mikoro ntiyemerewe. Yemerere mu Igenamiterere kugira ngo uvugishe umufasha.
voice.noSpeech: Nta jwi numvise — ongera ugerageze wegereye telefoni.
voice.failed: Gufata amajwi byanze — ongera ugerageze cyangwa wandike.
voice.languageUnavailable: Kuvugisha ijwi mu Kinyarwanda ntibirashoboka — andika ubutumwa bwawe.

title.addMenuItem: Ongera {{name}} kuri menu ku giciro cya {{price}}

card.name: Izina
card.failed: Kubika byanze — nta cyahindutse. Ongera ugerageze.
card.failedOffline: Nta murandasi — ongera ugerageze ugarutse ku murandasi. Ntibizabikwa kabiri.
card.failedConflict: Ibi byari byarakozwe, cyangwa byahindutse hagati aho.
card.failedInvalid: Seriveri ntiyemeye aya makuru — yahindure wongere ugerageze.
